title: S4 verdict (the only thing a judging role may say)
description: DRAFT 2026-11-16 (not frozen). This is the model's answer. The envelope (decision id, pack hash, seat, prompt version, timings, cost, rung) is added by code and lives in ai.decision; the model never supplies it. The model never supplies a price, a size in units, an instrument or a trade id. Checks beyond this schema are in c2-verdict-and-clamps.md.

action.description: trade_reviewer: proceed | shrink | skip. position_monitor: hold | lock_be | close.

size_multiplier.description: trade_reviewer: proceed = 1, shrink = 0.25, 0.5 or 0.75, skip = 0. position_monitor: always 1 (it does not resize).

evidence_ids.description: ids of items in the context pack that support the verdict. Empty only with NO_CONCERN or INSUFFICIENT_CONTEXT.

note.description: One or two plain sentences for the owner. Display only; nothing parses it.
